Along with the internet ventures , the label also serves as a record label .

Elister L. `` Larry '' Wilmore ( born October 30 , 1961 ) is an American comedian , writer , producer , and actor . Wilmore served as the `` Senior Black Correspondent '' on The Daily Show from 2006 to 2014 , and hosted The Nightly Show with Larry Wilmore from 2015 to 2016 .
